title: Docs sync after Phase 0: README, docs/DEPLOY.md and .env.example reflect the merged changes
spec:
Why: every Phase 0 task was told not to touch README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md or .env.example so parallel merges do not conflict; this task brings the three files up to date once everything is merged. Human decisions 2026-10-06: general tool for any team, English-first, no niche; no legal entity yet (nothing published).
What: read docs/STAGING.md, docs/OBSERVABILITY.md, docs/RELEASE.md, docs/legal/README.md, docs/checks/{capture-scope,demo-cleanup,models,cost-meter,unit-cost,workspace-switch,deferred-findings,e2e-live}.md and the merged code, then:
1. .env.example: add every new env name with a one-line comment (Sentry DSNs, SUPABASE_TEST_*, model overrides already present, CSC_*/APPLE_API_* belong in docs/RELEASE.md not here). Names only, no values.
2. README.md: env table rows for the new names; "Tests and checks" gains `npm run test:db` and the CI/nightly workflows; "Trust, privacy and limitations" states the new defaults (window capture preferred, only non-routine frames stored, 30-day default retention, frames still not pixel-redacted); "Known limitations": signing line updated to "signed builds ship through docs/RELEASE.md once the certificate exists"; the `[team]` placeholder is replaced by the existing Team paragraph if still present. Keep the DACH-free, general wording; remove any industry-specific example that slipped in.
3. docs/DEPLOY.md: sections for staging (pointer to docs/STAGING.md), observability env, cost meter migration, the GitHub Actions workflows and their secrets (names), and the nightly run.
4. A docs guard test (src/docs.guard.test.ts or similar) that every env name read via process.env under src/** and instrumentation*.ts appears in .env.example or in an allowlist in the test (VERCEL_*, NODE_ENV, CI).
No code changes beyond the guard test. No new dependencies.
acceptance: .env.example lists every new env name introduced by the Phase 0 tasks with a comment, values empty
README env table, tests section, trust section and known limitations match the merged code (cite the sections changed)
docs/DEPLOY.md covers staging, observability, cost meter migration, CI, nightly and release workflows
docs guard test: every process.env name under src/** and instrumentation*.ts is in .env.example or the allowlist
